top.title: Report: Trump Favors Economic Stranglehold on Iran Over Renewed Major Strikes
top.rewrite: Report: Trump Favors Economic Stranglehold on Iran Over Renewed Major Strikes
top.summary: Of four options put to him (a deal, a new major offensive, limited strikes or more economic pressure), Trump favours tightening the economic squeeze on Iran, Israel Hayom reported, citing three diplomatic sources. That means keeping the naval blockade and pressing Gulf states to shut Iranian oil-smuggling routes through Iraq.

featured.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
featured.rewrite: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
featured.summary: The Sparta II, a US-sanctioned cargo ship bound for Kaliningrad, caught fire after a drone strike on Saturday and drifted into Finnish waters. Finland's defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind it; PM Petteri Orpo said 'war is spilling over into our immediate vicinity.' Finland also suspects a Russian helicopter violated its airspace.

featured.title: Trump on credit card interest rate cap: ‘I would do it’
featured.rewrite: Trump on credit card interest rate cap: 'I would do it'
featured.summary: Asked on Fox's 'Saturday in America' whether the one-year 10% cap on credit card interest rates he floated in January could be a deal with Democrats, Trump said 'I would do it.' Leading Democratic figures also back a cap.

featured.title: NYC suspect in Chinatown fatal beating had 5 open cases as Mamdani pushes plan to close Rikers
featured.rewrite: NYC suspect in Chinatown fatal beating had 5 open cases as Mamdani pushes plan to close Rikers
featured.summary: Alexander Florentino, 25, is charged with murder after a 62-year-old woman was beaten to death in Manhattan's Chinatown on Friday. Court records show he had five open cases, including three November arrests, and was due in court on Dec. 14. It came as Mayor Mamdani unveiled a plan to close Rikers by 2032.

featured.title: Amazon urges NYC residents to call their officials as $3T company threatens to impose $5 delivery fees in the Big Apple as fight with Mamdani escalates
featured.rewrite: Amazon urges NYC residents to call their officials as $3T company threatens to impose $5 delivery fees in...
featured.summary: Pop-ups on Amazon's site tell New Yorkers the city council 'could add up to $5 per order' and urge them to lobby against the Delivery Protection Act, which would require firms to get licences and hire drivers directly. Mamdani and a council majority back the bill, which could pass before year's end.

left.title: Furious Trump was 'all set to fire' another top official after his humiliating Epstein island confession… until a $25million donation 'helped change his mind'
left.rewrite: Furious Trump was 'all set to fire' another top official after his humiliating Epstein island confession…...
left.summary: The official is Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who the Daily Mail says narrowly avoided being fired after his ties to Jeffrey Epstein were revealed. The report comes amid questions over Trump's cabinet after the midterm losses.

left.title: Heartbroken widow of Brooklyn building collapse victim blasts city at vigil: ‘Failed to do their job’
left.rewrite: Heartbroken widow of Brooklyn building collapse victim blasts city at vigil: 'Failed to do their job'
left.summary: Families of those killed in the deadly Brooklyn building collapse turned on city officials at a vigil at the site on Saturday, with one widow saying the city 'failed to do their job.'

left.title: President Trump appears to endorse new Democratic senator Abdul El-Sayed's 'TrumpCare' plan to give all Americans healthcare
left.rewrite: President Trump appears to endorse new Democratic senator Abdul El-Sayed's 'TrumpCare' plan to give all...
left.summary: Michigan's Democratic senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed has pitched a universal healthcare plan branded 'TrumpCare', even using a fake gold card on November 12 to try to win the president over. Trump has now appeared to back the idea.

left.title: Schumer’s opposition to 2018 Iran nuke deal weaponized in Senate leadership race
left.rewrite: Schumer's opposition to 2018 Iran nuke deal weaponized in Senate leadership race
left.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen is using Schumer's past opposition to the Iran nuclear deal in his bid to replace the New York Democrat as Senate majority leader in the new Congress.

left.title: Mamdani’s ‘close Rikers’ plan pours millions more tax dollars into program paying residents to house ex-con family members
left.rewrite: Mamdani's 'close Rikers' plan pours millions more tax dollars into program paying residents to house...
left.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani's plan to close Rikers would expand a little-known program that pays New Yorkers to house family members returning from jail.

left.title: NYC 911 call center fights major bedbug infestation — forcing staff to work from home, pulling cops from streets to answer phones
left.rewrite: NYC 911 call center fights major bedbug infestation — forcing staff to work from home, pulling cops from...
left.summary: The infestation at the NYPD's 911 call centre in Brooklyn has sent staff home to work and forced the department to pull uniformed officers off the streets to help answer calls.

left.title: Trump says Vance, Rubio are 'doing fantastically' ahead of 2028 Republican presidential primary
left.rewrite: Trump says Vance, Rubio are 'doing fantastically' ahead of 2028 Republican presidential primary
left.summary: Asked by Kayleigh McEnany on Fox's 'Saturday in America' about 2028, Trump called Vance and Rubio 'both very, very popular.' On the Democratic side he said Kamala Harris was doing 'pretty well,' praised AOC, and predicted the nominee may be 'somebody that nobody ever heard of.'

left.title: Rail safety legislation within reach for Senate Democrats after midterm blue tsunami
left.rewrite: Rail safety legislation within reach for Senate Democrats after midterm blue tsunami
left.summary: After the Republican midterm wipeout, Senate Democrats will be four votes shy of a supermajority next Congress, giving rail safety legislation a real shot at passing.

left.title: Mamdani’s plan to dismantle NYPD’s riot unit ripped as ‘smoke and mirrors’ by former force leaders
left.rewrite: Mamdani's plan to dismantle NYPD's riot unit ripped as 'smoke and mirrors' by former force leaders
left.summary: Former NYPD chief John Chell says Mayor Zohran Mamdani's plan to gut the Strategic Response Group is 'smoke and mirrors,' claiming the unit will simply be rebranded.

left.title: How a hair and makeup bill is upending the RNC chairman race
left.rewrite: How a hair and makeup bill is upending the RNC chairman race
left.summary: Allies of RNC co-chairwoman KC Crosbie argue the committee mismanaged campaign money during the midterms, using a hair and makeup bill to press their case that the party needs new leadership.

left.title: Disgraced Trump official jailed for reckless behavior defended vile speeding crimes he was found guilty of in 'Psychotic' Reddit posts
left.rewrite: Disgraced Trump official jailed for reckless behavior defended vile speeding crimes he was found guilty of...
left.summary: Aaron Kofsky, 29, a senior deputy to FHFA director Bill Pulte, spent two nights in jail after being caught driving over 100mph in Virginia, and defended the behavior in several Reddit posts.

left.title: Woman found dead with neck trauma in NYC apartment building as police arrest person of interest
left.rewrite: Woman found dead with neck trauma in NYC apartment building as police arrest person of interest
left.summary: Officers responding to a 911 call at 27 Catherine St. around 3:22 p.m. found the woman unconscious and unresponsive. Police have arrested a person of interest.

left.title: Mamdani Tore His Achilles Chasing the Ball in Soccer Game Against NYC Press Corps
left.rewrite: Mamdani Tore His Achilles Chasing the Ball in Soccer Game Against NYC Press Corps
left.summary: Mamdani, 35, tore his right Achilles tendon Thursday night playing soccer against the City Hall press corps and expects to wear a boot for six to eight weeks. He said he had skipped stretching; no one made contact on the play.

left.title: Locals of Michigan city with largest Muslim population in US call El-Sayed election victory 'needed' change
left.rewrite: Locals of Michigan city with largest Muslim population in US call El-Sayed election victory 'needed' change
left.summary: Dearborn residents praised Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed's win as the first Muslim American elected to the US Senate, telling Fox News Digital that Michigan 'needed a change.' About half the city's population is Muslim.

left.title: Boebert’s midterm post-mortem: ‘I think it’s all of it’
left.rewrite: Boebert's midterm post-mortem: 'I think it's all of it'
left.summary: Outgoing Rep. Lauren Boebert told the AP that Trump administration policies and congressional stagnation cost her Colorado's 4th District seat, saying gas prices and the Iran war opened a rift between the GOP and working-class voters.

left.title: Mamdani couldn’t explain how NYC-run grocery stores will afford 30% discounts
left.rewrite: Mamdani couldn't explain how NYC-run grocery stores will afford 30% discounts
left.summary: Mamdani has promised five publicly funded, privately run stores selling staples at an average 30% below retail. City documents show taxpayers would build them, pay rent and property taxes and cover operators' discount losses; experts doubt the pledge.

left.title: DeSantis shoots down prospect of sitting on Supreme Court
left.rewrite: DeSantis shoots down prospect of sitting on Supreme Court
left.summary: In a New York Times interview published Friday, outgoing Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis said he doesn't want to 'end up a potted plant on the Supreme Court,' saying he prefers to lead as an executive.

left.title: Supreme Court sitting on emergency petition over Washington’s transgender sports policies
left.rewrite: Supreme Court sitting on emergency petition over Washington's transgender sports policies
left.summary: Wrestler Kallie Keeler, represented by Alliance Defending Freedom, filed an emergency petition on Oct. 2 asking the justices to halt Washington's policy letting biological males compete in girls' sports, after two lower courts declined. The court has yet to act, a question complicated by a newly passed ballot measure.

left.title: Poll: Americans Still Say Most Illegal Aliens Should Be Deported; Only 7% Believe All Should Stay
left.rewrite: Poll: Americans Still Say Most Illegal Aliens Should Be Deported; Only 7% Believe All Should Stay
left.summary: An Economist/YouGov post-midterm survey found 51% say most illegal immigrants should be deported (23% all immediately, 28% most with exceptions), while 41% say only those who committed serious crimes should be, and 7% say all should stay.

left.title: Iran takes pointed jab at Trump Cabinet secretary for moving onto military base
left.rewrite: Iran takes pointed jab at Trump Cabinet secretary for moving onto military base
left.summary: Iran's embassy in South Africa mocked Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent as 'sweetie' on X after reports he moved from his Washington home onto a military base amid security threats attributed to Tehran. He is the latest senior Trump official to relocate behind military gates.

left.title: Trump responds after Vance blames Iran war for midterm losses, VP says his job is to support president
left.rewrite: Trump responds after Vance blames Iran war for midterm losses, VP says his job is to support president
left.summary: Trump said Friday he would launch the Iran operation again 'because we cannot allow Iran to have a nuclear weapon,' pushing back on reports of friction after Vance blamed Republican midterm losses on voter anger over the war and oil prices. Trump said he thought Vance's statement was 'fine.'

left.title: Hawley leaves door open to 2028 presidential campaign after previously ruling out bid
left.rewrite: Hawley leaves door open to 2028 presidential campaign after previously ruling out bid
left.summary: Sen. Josh Hawley said Thursday he is considering a 2028 White House bid. In September he told the Washington Examiner he had 'no intention of doing so, period.' A run could pit him against JD Vance and Marco Rubio.

left.title: California county under congressional scrutiny over taxpayer-funded voter turnout campaign targeting Democrats
left.rewrite: California county under congressional scrutiny over taxpayer-funded voter turnout campaign targeting Democrats
left.summary: A swing California county's voter registration office faces congressional scrutiny after an investigative report found local election officials used taxpayer resources specifically to turn out Democratic voters for the 2026 midterms.

left.title: REVEALED: Mamdani was arrested TWICE by tactical NYPD unit he disbanded
left.rewrite: REVEALED: Mamdani was arrested TWICE by tactical NYPD unit he disbanded
left.summary: A review of photos and video by Crain's New York Business found the NYPD's Strategic Response Group arrested Mamdani at least twice between 2021 and 2024, including at a June 2024 rent protest at Hunter College. He has now disbanded the unit, as he promised during his campaign.

left.title: Liberals are FURIOUS after Republican wins Alaska seat — with 'spoiler' candidate incarcerated in New York
left.rewrite: Liberals are FURIOUS after Republican wins Alaska seat — with 'spoiler' candidate incarcerated in New York
left.summary: Republican Nick Begich held Alaska's only House seat with about 51.4% of the vote to 48.7% for Democratic-endorsed independent Bill Hill, one of the last midterm races called. Some on the left blame a spoiler candidate who ran as a Democrat and has never visited Alaska.

left.title: Kansas Sen-elect Hamilton won't support Schumer for Majority Leader
left.rewrite: Kansas Sen-elect Hamilton won't support Schumer for Majority Leader

left.title: Mamdani Launches Plan to Empty and Close Rikers Island Jail
left.rewrite: Mamdani Launches Plan to Empty and Close Rikers Island Jail
left.summary: Mamdani announced Friday that Rikers Island will close by 2032. AP reports the city is all but certain to brush aside a legal requirement that closure be matched by four smaller, modern jails by 2027. Trump has previously criticised the plan.

left.title: Van Hollen scores support from another Dem amid Senate majority leader bid
left.rewrite: Van Hollen scores support from another Dem amid Senate majority leader bid
left.summary: Sen. Elissa Slotkin said she will back Sen. Chris Van Hollen for the Senate Democratic leadership role as he challenges Chuck Schumer.

left.title: Meet the Media’s Favorite ‘Sanctions Expert’: A 29-Year-Old With a Raft of Online Certifications and Little Real-World Experience
left.rewrite: Meet the Media's Favorite 'Sanctions Expert': A 29-Year-Old With a Raft of Online Certifications and...
left.summary: Brett Erickson of Obsidian Risk Advisers has been quoted by the New York Times, Politico, Bloomberg and others since the Iran war began, including 16 times by the Washington Post since March. The Free Beacon reports his background is mostly online certifications.

left.title: Trump's MAGA succession battle takes center stage in extraordinary press conference as he is asked to pick between Vance and Rubio
left.rewrite: Trump's MAGA succession battle takes center stage in extraordinary press conference as he is asked to pick...
left.summary: At a marathon White House press conference, Trump floated adviser Stephen Miller as his successor while JD Vance and Marco Rubio stood behind him. 'He was better than these two guys,' Trump said.

left.title: Honda, Toyota recall 1.6 million US vehicles over airbag rupture risk
left.rewrite: Honda, Toyota recall 1.6 million US vehicles over airbag rupture risk
left.summary: Honda and Toyota will replace Takata airbag inflators in 1.6 million US cars, trucks and SUVs. They report no crashes or injuries tied to the recalled vehicles, but the inflators have been blamed for at least 28 US deaths and over 400 injuries since 2009.

left.title: America's largest IPO ever carries potentially seismic implications for political spending ahead of 2028
left.rewrite: America's largest IPO ever carries potentially seismic implications for political spending ahead of 2028
left.summary: Anthropic debuted at a $1.5 trillion valuation, and its seven co-founders have each pledged to give away 80% of their equity.

left.title: Tinned food and long-life milk boost retail sales after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
left.rewrite: Tinned food and long-life milk boost retail sales after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
left.summary: Official figures show people stocking up on long-life food pushed UK retail sales higher in October, after the government's 'Be Ready' preparedness campaign launched.

center.title: Russian Missile Attack on Zelensky's Hometown in Central Ukraine Kills Two, Wounds Dozens
center.rewrite: Russian Missile Attack on Zelensky's Hometown in Central Ukraine Kills Two, Wounds Dozens
center.summary: A 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman were killed and 60 people wounded, six of them children, in a Friday-night strike on Kryvyi Rih, local officials said. The attack started four fires and damaged about 25 apartment buildings, a hospital and schools.

center.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
center.rewrite: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock

center.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
center.rewrite: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
center.summary: Speaking to CNN, Zelensky said it was up to Trump 'how to call Putin' but 'for us, he is an enemy... he's a killer.' Trump had called Putin his 'friend' on the sidelines of Thursday's trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping in China.

center.title: Katie Miller reposts then deletes Trump’s ‘whole civilization will die tonight’ warning on Iran
center.rewrite: Katie Miller reposts then deletes Trump's 'whole civilization will die tonight' warning on Iran
center.summary: Katie Miller shared a cropped screenshot of Trump's April post threatening that 'a whole civilization will die tonight,' then deleted it; it is unclear why she posted it. The US and Israel are reportedly weighing more strikes as indirect talks with Iran stall.

center.title: Young Iranian women risk their lives to join underground ballet network
center.rewrite: Young Iranian women risk their lives to join underground ballet network

center.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets Wes Streeting
center.rewrite: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets Wes Streeting
center.summary: Zelensky told the BBC the strikes answer 109 Russian attacks on Ukrainian bridges, rejecting Putin's claim the bridge is 'exclusively civilian' and pointing to images of Russian tanks using it. This week's Ukrainian strikes destroyed the bridge's central road section. UK minister Wes Streeting said he came to Kyiv to show Europe is united behind Ukraine.

center.title: Donald Trump wants Ukraine peace deal by January as he brands Russian missile strike on Poland 'mistake'
center.rewrite: Donald Trump wants Ukraine peace deal by January as he brands Russian missile strike on Poland 'mistake'
center.summary: Trump is pressing European leaders to get Kyiv to agree terms with Putin by early in the new year, before he loses control of Congress, according to reports. He appeared to shrug off Russia's strikes on Poland, saying Putin had been 'landing drones in Poland, and a couple of little missiles, by mistake.'

center.title: Russia open to ‘NATO-like’ status for Ukraine — but only if Putin can keep captured territory: US official
center.rewrite: Russia open to 'NATO-like' status for Ukraine — but only if Putin can keep captured territory: US official
center.summary: A US official said Moscow has signalled it is 'OK' with Ukraine receiving protections similar to NATO's Articles 4 and 5, provided Russia keeps the territory it has captured. The aim would be to get Ukraine 'as close to NATO as possible without the brand.'

center.title: Trump: Iran Wants Deal but Not One He’ll Accept — Demands ‘Real Deal,’ Slams 51 Years of ‘Bullsh–ting’
center.rewrite: Trump: Iran Wants Deal but Not One He'll Accept — Demands 'Real Deal,' Slams 51 Years of 'Bullsh–ting'
center.summary: Trump said Friday that Iran wants a deal but not one acceptable to him, accusing Tehran of stringing people along for 51 years. The remarks followed new talks between US envoys and Qatari mediators as Washington keeps its naval blockade of Iran and weighs more strikes.

center.title: Iran Rebuffs United Front Against It at Trump-Xi-Putin Summit
center.rewrite: Iran Rebuffs United Front Against It at Trump-Xi-Putin Summit
center.summary: Senior Iranian officials tried to frame the Trump-Xi-Putin summit as a win for Iran, contrary to the leaders' joint statement.

center.title: Putin launches Ukraine barrage hours after Trump meeting amid alleged Russian missile breach of NATO airspace
center.rewrite: Putin launches Ukraine barrage hours after Trump meeting amid alleged Russian missile breach of NATO airspace
center.summary: Russia fired more than 400 drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine overnight Friday, killing at least eight people and striking three major bridges in Kyiv, hours after Putin stood with Trump and Xi at their summit in China. Suspected Russian missiles and a drone also entered NATO member Poland.

center.title: Trump claims Putin told him he would have never invaded Ukraine if he were president - as he's slammed in Europe over 'friend' comment
center.rewrite: Trump claims Putin told him he would have never invaded Ukraine if he were president - as he's slammed in...
center.summary: 'I actually asked him, I said, "Would you have gone in if I was president?" He said, "No, would have never happened,"' Trump told reporters at the White House on Friday, as European critics hit out at him for calling Putin a 'friend.'

center.title: 'One-in-2,000-year weather' to be investigated post-blackout
center.rewrite: 'One-in-2,000-year weather' to be investigated post-blackout
center.summary: The SA government says ElectraNet's claim that 'one-in-2,000-year weather' likely caused the Eyre Peninsula blackout will be examined in its investigation. Power to the peninsula and West Coast was cut on Thursday when two transmission towers collapsed.

center.title: Spirit of Tasmania operator told not to use autopilot for entire voyage
center.rewrite: Spirit of Tasmania operator told not to use autopilot for entire voyage
center.summary: The Australian Maritime Safety Authority has ordered TT-Line to keep both new Spirit of Tasmania ferries in hand steering for the whole Bass Strait crossing while it probes an 'intermittent fault' in Spirit IV's steering system.

center.title: One Nation rules out deal with Coalition in NSW
center.rewrite: One Nation rules out deal with Coalition in NSW
center.summary: NSW One Nation leader Mike Newman told a firearms forum the party 'will never' form a coalition with the Coalition, and vowed to repeal gun laws passed after the Bondi Beach terror attack. He also took aim at Liberal leader Kellie Sloane, who lost an eighth MP last week.

center.title: Victoria Point woman waited seven hours for ambulance before death
center.rewrite: Victoria Point woman waited seven hours for ambulance before death
center.summary: The Brisbane woman waited almost seven hours for an ambulance before she died, the latest in a string of 'avoidable deaths' in Queensland.

center.title: Roos survive Swans scare to book trip to fourth straight AFLW decider
center.rewrite: Roos survive Swans scare to book trip to fourth straight AFLW decider
center.summary: North Melbourne advanced to its fourth consecutive AFLW grand final after surviving a stiff test from Sydney at Princes Park.

center.title: One Nation lands $25k donation from Tasmanian salmon company
center.rewrite: One Nation lands $25k donation from Tasmanian salmon company
center.summary: The gifts are the largest received by a political party in Tasmania since new disclosure rules took effect last year. One Nation in Tasmania is led by Lee Hanson, daughter of founder Pauline Hanson.

center.title: Emergency fire warning downgraded in Victoria's north-west
center.rewrite: Emergency fire warning downgraded in Victoria's north-west
center.summary: The warning near Nandaly is now Watch and Act. The fast-moving grassfire started after 3pm about 55km south-east of Ouyen and has burnt around 1,300 hectares, with residents told to keep monitoring conditions.

center.title: Bellamy to end Storm coaching stint after 2027 NRL season
center.rewrite: Bellamy to end Storm coaching stint after 2027 NRL season
center.summary: Craig Bellamy will leave the Melbourne Storm at the end of the 2027 NRL season, ending a 25-season tenure, the longest in NRL premiership history.

center.title: Greens win court fight against Prahran independent how to-vote-cards
center.rewrite: Greens win court fight against Prahran independent how to-vote-cards
center.summary: The Supreme Court ordered Prahran independent Tosh-Jake Finnigan not to hand out how-to-vote cards imitating the Greens' colours and font. Separately, the Liberals pledged to make Victoria's top prosecutor face annual questioning in parliament.

center.title: Police investigate three Melbourne stabbings, one fatal
center.rewrite: Police investigate three Melbourne stabbings, one fatal
center.summary: A 21-year-old man died after an alleged stabbing on La Trobe Street in Melbourne's CBD, and three teens have been arrested. Police are also investigating two other stabbings, including one at Bourke Street Mall that injured a 24-year-old man.

center.title: Intervention not jail: youth crime plea ahead of Victorian election
center.rewrite: Intervention not jail: youth crime plea ahead of Victorian election
center.summary: Youth advocates want more early intervention for young offenders, arguing hardline approaches are costly and ineffective. The Liberals are promising boot camps for some juveniles, while Labor pledges mandatory rehabilitation detention for low- and mid-level offenders.

center.title: Anthropic stock slides with rest of market after big-ticker IPO
center.rewrite: Anthropic stock slides with rest of market after big-ticker IPO
center.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share on Thursday. The stock surged at first, then slid with the broader tech sell-off to end the week, as markets digested Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia and Democrats retaking Congress.

center.title: Bitcoin bounces 9% from two-year low to retake $60,000 as traders eye Monday’s stock open
center.rewrite: Bitcoin bounces 9% from two-year low to retake $60,000 as traders eye Monday's stock open
center.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $60,000, up more than 9% from an early low of $55,130, its weakest since September 2024. The sell-off wiped out about $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, $1.3 billion of them bullish bets, per CoinGlass. Analysts say a lasting recovery depends on tech stocks stabilising.

center.title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
center.rewrite: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
center.summary: Bitcoin fell below $57,000 on Friday, its lowest since September 2024, deepening a bear market from its peak above $126,000 and a 28% quarterly drop. The sell-off spread to tech stocks, gold, copper and Asian shares; analysts cite rising real Treasury yields and a more hawkish Fed.

center.title: Wall Street suffers historic losses as Dow, S&P 500 plunge into correction territory
center.rewrite: Wall Street suffers historic losses as Dow, S&P 500 plunge into correction territory
center.summary: The Dow fell nearly 950 points, the S&P 500 dropped 3.7% and the Nasdaq plunged 5.28% on Friday as an AI sell-off pushed the Dow and S&P 500 into correction territory, at least 10% below recent records. Nvidia tumbled about 14% and newly listed Anthropic fell 9%, erasing the Nasdaq's gains for the year.

center.title: Anthropic co-founder to make ‘large gift’ to Trump’s investment accounts for kids after record IPO: Bessent
center.rewrite: Anthropic co-founder to make 'large gift' to Trump's investment accounts for kids after record IPO: Bessent
center.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC that one of Anthropic's founders will make 'a large gift' to Trump Accounts for children over the next few weeks.

center.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
center.rewrite: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
center.summary: Anthropic's shares slid back toward their initial price after a soaring first day as a wider tech sell-off deepened. By Friday lunchtime the S&P 500 was down more than 2% and the Dow 0.7%, with both indexes touching correction territory, 10% or more below a recent high.

center.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
center.rewrite: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
center.summary: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH moved over two days as the hackers shifted the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to hide the trail.

right.title: Second British Village Votes to Secede From UK over Migrant Camp Scheme
right.rewrite: Second British Village Votes to Secede From UK over Migrant Camp Scheme
right.summary: Barnham residents voted 257 to 16 (94%) in a non-binding ballot to seek Crown Dependency status, protesting plans to house up to 930 asylum seekers at a former RAF site outside the village.

right.title: Girl, 15, is raped in London park as police arrest two men aged 27 and 29
right.rewrite: Girl, 15, is raped in London park as police arrest two men aged 27 and 29
right.summary: Detectives are questioning two men, aged 27 and 29, over the alleged attack at Rosehill Park West in Sutton, south London, on Friday.

right.title: Former IRGC commander behind Iran's brutal hijab crackdown to give keynote speech at London 'Islamophobia' conference
right.rewrite: Former IRGC commander behind Iran's brutal hijab crackdown to give keynote speech at London 'Islamophobia'...
right.summary: A former Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commander linked to Iran's hijab crackdown is due to deliver a keynote speech at a London conference on Islamophobia.

right.title: British swimmer completes daring 9-mile challenge through Strait of Hormuz amid Iran War

right.summary: Lewis Pugh, the 56-year-old Plymouth-born endurance swimmer and UN patron of the oceans, finished a three-day swim through the Strait of Hormuz while attacks on oil tankers continue in the waterway.

right.title: Putin's recklessness could spark World War Three, warns defence intelligence chief after Russian missiles hit near British soldiers
right.rewrite: Putin's recklessness could spark World War Three, warns defence intelligence chief after Russian missiles...
right.summary: The UK's Chief of Defence Intelligence spoke after Russian missiles and drones struck Poland close to where British troops are carrying out drills.

right.title: Pair linked to fake bomb alert outside RAF Fairford to stand trial next year
right.rewrite: Pair linked to fake bomb alert outside RAF Fairford to stand trial next year
right.summary: Two men charged over a fake bomb alert outside RAF Fairford, allegedly on Iran's orders, will deny wrongdoing and face trial next year, a court heard.

right.title: UK should only rejoin EU if it innovates on technology, Blair warns
right.rewrite: UK should only rejoin EU if it innovates on technology, Blair warns
right.summary: Sir Tony Blair told The Sunday Times that any return to the EU should be 'heavily conditioned' on reform, saying the bloc is probably heading the wrong way on tech innovation. He still called Brexit 'a real mistake.'

right.title: Trump appoints former makeup executive to replace ousted National Cyber Director he branded 'not good enough' amid tech outage chaos
right.rewrite: Trump appoints former makeup executive to replace ousted National Cyber Director he branded 'not good...
right.summary: The appointment follows a string of major outages that hit Microsoft, nationwide air traffic control, JPMorgan Chase, United Airlines and Apple.

right.summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for the bug, which was flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block's Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

right.title: Donald Trump could put billions of UK investment on ice with vow to punish tech giants for overseas data centres
right.rewrite: Donald Trump could put billions of UK investment on ice with vow to punish tech giants for overseas data...
right.summary: Trump said tech firms that build large AI data centres in other countries would face a 'tremendous tax', a threat that could stall billions in planned UK investment.

right.title: Tech outage cascade exposes US vulnerabilities to foreign cyber threats
right.rewrite: Tech outage cascade exposes US vulnerabilities to foreign cyber threats
right.summary: Six days of outages have hit Microsoft 365, banks and the NSA's network. Administration officials have ruled out a coordinated cyberattack, but security experts say the failures show how damaging infrastructure disruption could be in a conflict.

right.title: Hackers use Microsoft Outlook security flaw to steal your login data
right.rewrite: Hackers use Microsoft Outlook security flaw to steal your login data
right.summary: The flaw, CVE-2026-124194, lets a malicious .msg file expose NTLMv2 authentication data, and Microsoft confirms hackers have already exploited it.

right.rewrite: Russell Crowe's Request to Shoot 'A Beautiful Mind' Chronologically Added $1 Million to the Budget, Says...

right.title: E.J. Carroll, ‘Law & Order,’ ‘GTA 5’ and ‘Blue Bloods’ Actor, Dies at 66
right.rewrite: E.J. Carroll, 'Law & Order,' 'GTA 5' and 'Blue Bloods' Actor, Dies at 66
right.summary: Carroll died suddenly on Thursday, his rep told Variety; no cause of death has been given. His nearly 30-year career included 'The Deuce,' 'Law & Order,' 'Grand Theft Auto V' and Darren Aronofsky's 'The Wrestler.'

right.title: CMA Awards See a 55% Ratings Bump in Key Adult Demo With Taylor Swift’s Return to the Show
right.rewrite: CMA Awards See a 55% Ratings Bump in Key Adult Demo With Taylor Swift's Return to the Show
right.summary: With Taylor Swift performing at the CMA Awards for the first time in 13 years, the 60th telecast was up 26% in total viewers and 55% among adults 18-49 on last year.
